message: So there I was, cooking up a storm in the kitchen, my phone propped up on the counter, playing my favorite podcast. Suddenly, the smoke alarm blares and the phone dies right then and there! Talk about a wake-up call! I realized I need a solid escape plan that doesn't rely on tech. Now, I keep a printed plan by the fridge and make sure we practice it as a family. Have you all thought about your escape routes? What’s your go-to fire safety tip?
